title: EY Triennial Cycle
note: Torah readings following the Eretz Yisrael triennial (three-year) reading cycle, per the source spreadsheet לוח סדרי קריאת התורה. Sidra numbers restart at א within each book; across the three-year cycle, which sidra is read on a given Shabbat depends on the year. Use the "Aliyot" toggle above to also show the suggested 7-aliyah breakdown for each sidra.
